title: Incombustible
summary: INCOMBUST'IBLE, adjective [in and combustible.] Not to be burnt, decomposed or consumed by fire. Amianth is an incombustible substance.

inlines.v: INCOMBUST'IBLE, adjective [in and combustible.] Not to be burnt, decomposed or consumed by fire. Amianth is an incombustible substance.
